skillBank.name: dotnet
skillBank.description: Use when reviewing C# or .NET application changes.
skillBank.instructions: Check cancellation propagation, disposal of owned resources, nullable handling and asynchronous operations. Report only concrete defects supported by added lines in the supplied diff.

skillBank.name: api-security
skillBank.description: Use when reviewing endpoints, authentication or authorization changes.
skillBank.instructions: Check authorization before data access, tenant isolation, validation of identifiers, and whether sensitive values enter responses or logs. Explain the triggering request and impact for each supported defect.

skillBank.name: database
skillBank.description: Use when reviewing schema migrations or persistence changes.
skillBank.instructions: Check compatibility with existing readers and writers, data loss, transaction boundaries, and unbounded queries where the diff provides evidence. Do not assume migration execution or runtime performance has been verified.
